title: A brilliant way to experience the city
text:
What a fantastic way to see the city from a completely different perspective! Our guide was exceptionally knowledgeable, making the whole experience both engaging and informative.

Having the group capped at no more than 12 people made it feel personal and relaxed, and it was wonderful sharing the experience with such a great mix of people from all over.

title: Like a stroll with friends
text:
A lovely pleasant evening with a small group. Our guide Victoria was charming, friendly and  knowledgeable about the food and her city. 
The tapas tastings were delicious and we definitely didn’t need a dinner afterwards. The included drinks were very enjoyable.
